impact: Selling into Nvidia's beat signals the AI trade is still fragile, limiting the relief bounce for MU, DRAM, SNXX and NBIS; hawkish Fed minutes could extend the S&P's losing streak.
summary: Nvidia, up 3.7% premarket on its $130B guide, reversed and closed down 2.9% amid uncertainty over Jensen Huang's departure. The Dow fell 1.11% to 50,198.17 and the S&P 500 slipped 0.23% to 7,323.64, its fifth straight loss and longest streak since June, while the Nasdaq rose 0.42% to 24,429.89. Hawkish Fed minutes weighed late; AMD and Broadcom rose, and TJX and Target jumped on upbeat outlooks.
title: Dow falls 1.1%, S&P 500 fifth straight loss; Nvidia down 2.9% despite beat
